notes.title: 0.4.0 Release – Back to the College
notes.content: [p]The latest version of Back to the College is now live![/p][p]You can now dive deeper into the twisted, seductive, and mysterious world of campus life, where every choice shapes your destiny.[/p][list][*][p]55,000 words of story[/p][/*][*][p]2,900 images[/p][/*][*][p]95 animations[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]🍌 New Banana Option Available![/p][p]Some players pointed out that MC’s... equipment was a bit over the top.[/p][p]Well, we believe every experience should feel just right — even the ones below the belt.[/p][p]Starting today, you can choose: Big Banana or Massive Banana, directly from the options menu![/p][p]That’s right. Whether you prefer a touch of realism or full-on exaggeration, the choice is yours.[/p][p]After all, the world of Back to the College is big enough for every kind of fruit. 😉[/p][p]Romance, secrets, moral dilemmas, and supernatural mischief await.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45605359/de40e172db83ab31023458069204bf220f4ac40b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🎉 Back to the College is finally out on Steam! 🎉
notes.content:
[p]After a long wait… it’s here.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Back to the College[/i], the interactive visual novel packed with mystery, moral choices, romance, and dark humor, is officially available![/p][p][/p][p]👨‍⚖️ A brilliant lawyer dies… and wakes up in the body of a 25-year-old college guy.[/p][p]
😇 A clumsy angel and a seductive demon will guide him through his “second chance” on Earth.[/p][p]
🏫 Intrigue, flirting, twists, and buried truths await in a campus where nothing is quite what it seems.[/p][p][/p][p]Every decision you make changes the story.
Will you protect or manipulate? Love or betray?
[b]Who will you become… this time?[/b][/p]
